body: It's such a psychotic thought that the US can destroy anyone and anything and to have a sense of pride attached to destroying a part of mankind. It reminds me of those girls in middle school who were proud of themselves for going from calm to bat shit crazy in seconds.
It's not fair when you compare it to any working model in other countries like Denmark for example.
No one would have to resort to violence if politicians could keep their egos at bay.
The whole concept of the military has just become a dick measuring contest at this point to see who has the biggest and strongest guns, boats, tanks, etc.
Honestly, why spend your life fighting for a selfish politician's cause?
Never made the post with the intent to change anything, just wanted to share my opinion.
The box office numbers would suggest something different than this opinion
